Name: T's Craftable Auto-Petter
Author: tikamin557
Description:
There seems to be a similar mod, but since it currently doesn't function properly, I created a new one that allows for detailed adjustments.

Enables crafting of Auto-Petter.
You can customize recipe requirements and crafting materials using ModConfig settings.

[color=#ffff00][size=3]The default settings for recipe emails and crafting materials are as follows:[/size][/color]
[color=#00ffff][size=4]"Recipe Release Conditions"[/size][/color]
・Farming Skill Level: 8
・Mine Exploration Level: Skull Cavern Level 100
[color=#00ffff][size=4]"Recipe Materials"[/size][/color]
・Material 1 (Type): Hardwood
・Material 1 (Quantity): 300
・Material 2 (Type): Battery Pack
・Material 2 (Quantity): 20
・Material 3 (Type): Golden Mystery Box
・Material 3 (Quantity): 5

(Changing the “Mine Exploration Level” from the default “Skull Cavern Level 100” will alter the content of the mail.)

Currently, English and Japanese translation files are included

[b]You can find other mods in a similar series here.[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45384]T's Craftable Auto-Grabber[/url]
